label: marine biome
description: This biome includes open-ocean and unprotected coastal ecosystems, characterized by exposure to wave action, tidal fluctuation, and ocean currents as well as systems that largely resemble these. Water in the marine biome is generally within the salinity range of seawater: 30 to 38 ppt.

label: freshwater biome
description: An aquatic biome which is determined by a body of freshwater.

label: terrestrial biome
description: A biome which is  primarily or completely situated on a landmass.

label: ocean
description: A marine water body which is constitutes the majority of an astronomical body's hydrosphere.

label: river
description: A stream which, through permanent or seasonal flow processes, moves from elevated land towards lower elevations through a definite channel and empties either into a sea, lake, or another river or ends on land as bed seepage and evapotranspiration exceed water supply.

label: lake
description: A body of water or other liquid of considerable size contained in a depression on a landmass.

label: estuary
description: A semi-enclosed coastal body of water with one or more rivers or streams flowing into it, and with a free connection to the open sea.

label: coral reef
description: A marine reef which is composed primarily of aragonite structures produced by living organisms, found in shallow, low-nutrient waters.

label: intertidal zone
description: Very similar to the "marine eulittoral zone" class, but without reference to seasonal tide marks. Some sources make no distinction between these zones, thus, they are currently related synonyms.

label: soil
description: An environmental material which is primarily composed of minerals, varying proportions of sand, silt, and clay, organic material such as humus, interstitial gases, liquids, and a broad range of resident micro- and macroorganisms.

label: sediment
description: Sediment is typically deposited on the bed or bottom of a body of water or other liquid.

label: rhizosphere
description: The narrow region of soil that is directly influenced by root secretions and associated soil microorganisms.

label: temperature
description: A physical quality of the thermal energy of a system.

label: acidity
description: A concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing acid (hydrogen ions).

label: light switch
description: A switch which turns a light on or off.
